\[
\frac{n}{2} \times (first\_term + last\_term)

\text{Sum} = \frac{20}{2} \times (1 + 20) = 10 \times 21 = 210
\]

Thus, the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 20 is \(\boxed{210}\).

\]

No mistakes here.
